description: Stage progression patterns to detect stalled initiatives (Enhancement 7)

announcement_to_pilot.description: From initial announcement to pilot/PoC start

announcement_to_production.description: Complete journey from announcement to production

stall_indicators.description: Signals that initiative may have stalled

no_progression.condition: Announcement with no follow-up evidence for > stall_threshold
no_progression.rationale: Strategic announcements without follow-through suggest limited commitment

pilot_stall.condition: Pilot announced but no production evidence after threshold
pilot_stall.rationale: Stalled pilots indicate implementation challenges or deprioritization

vendor_only_progress.condition: Progress only visible through vendor announcements
vendor_only_progress.rationale: Bank silence while vendor announces suggests outsourcing

fast_pilot.rationale: Fast progression indicates strong organizational commitment

fast_production.rationale: Rapid production deployment shows mature capability

regulatory_catalyst.rationale: Deadline-driven adoption doesn't indicate strategic commitment

stage_evidence_mapping.description: Map evidence types to adoption stages

rules.rule: Production date cannot precede pilot date
rules.action: Flag for review; may indicate missing evidence

rules.rule: Pilot date cannot precede announcement date

rules.action: Flag; suggests incremental rollout or vendor solution

usage_notes: Use timeline_analyzer.py to detect stalled initiatives
Stall detection is a PRAGMATIST signal (not ARCHITECT)
Fast progression is an ARCHITECT signal
Always check for vendor-only evidence pattern
